free_tier.stated: GoDrive EFSS is 'completely free' but only as a component of on-premises GoAnywhere MFT. Capacity is your server's disk; there is no hosted free storage.

interface_detail: sftp / ftp / webdav / rest (GoDrive web UI)
tooling: GoAnywhere MFT installer + GoDrive module; FileCatalyst Service as an accelerator
chaining: Same shape as ExaVault: free software that runs on hardware a user does not own, so it is not an option here.
